The evidence indicates that Slc5a1 is involved in the regulation of this symporter activity, suggesting a possible functional link between Canagliflozin and Slc5a1. The binding of Canagliflozin to Slc5a2 may modulate the activity of Slc5a1, potentially affecting glucose reabsorption and excretion.
